BRIGEPOINT — BEFORE YOUR CRM TRIAL
Independent educational checklist. No purchase or referral signup required.

1. Choose one use case: missed calls, appointment follow-up or review requests.
2. Write down how your current process works and what is missing.
3. List your required integrations and access permissions.
4. Review the selected subscription, trial end date and usage charges.
5. Confirm the live session date, time zone and joining instructions.
6. Bring a laptop/desktop, stable connection and one clear question.
7. Use test contacts you control. Obtain appropriate consent before messaging others.
8. Reserve time to practise and ask official support about gaps.
9. Set a reminder several days before the trial ends.
10. Decide whether the ongoing cost and effort suit your needs; cancel in time if not.

Questions about this checklist: g2wsales@gmail.com
